title: Nature Is Quietly Billing The World For Invasive Species
hook: That's more than most countries make.
closing: Nature sent the world a bill nobody budgeted for.
question: Ever had an invasive species ruin your yard?

segments.say: The global bill for invasive species has roughly quadrupled every decade since 1970, reaching 423 billion dollars a year.
Almost all of it, over 90 percent, pays for damage already done.
Over 37 thousand alien species have taken hold worldwide.
